question: A patient who drinks 60 g of alcohol daily but has never experienced tolerance, withdrawal, or loss of control meets ICD-11 criteria for alcohol dependence.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is FALSE. ICD-11 dependence requires at least three of the six dependence criteria persisting over 12 months. High-volume drinking without tolerance, withdrawal, or impaired control is classified as Harmful Use, not dependence. Conflating the two leads to over-diagnosis and inappropriate pharmacotherapy.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. ICD-11 alcohol dependence requires at least three of the six dependence criteria (tolerance, withdrawal, impaired control, neglect of activities, persistent use despite harm, compulsion) over 12 months. Heavy daily use alone — without these features — satisfies criteria for Harmful Use (a pattern causing actual harm), NOT dependence.
